PSA 77:1.KJV: To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of Asaph. I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.
PSA 77:1.BHSA: קֹולִ֣י אֶל־אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאֶצְעָ֑קָה קֹולִ֥י אֶל־אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים וְהַאֲזִ֥ין אֵלָֽי׃

PSA 77:2.KJV: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.
PSA 77:2.BHSA: בְּיֹ֥ום צָרָתִי֮ אֲדֹנָ֢י דָּ֫רָ֥שְׁתִּי יָדִ֤י׀ לַ֣יְלָה נִ֭גְּרָה וְלֹ֣א תָפ֑וּג מֵאֲנָ֖ה הִנָּחֵ֣ם נַפְשִֽׁי׃

PSA 77:3.KJV: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
PSA 77:3.BHSA: אֶזְכְּרָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֣ים וְאֶֽהֱמָיָ֑ה אָשִׂ֓יחָה׀ וְתִתְעַטֵּ֖ף רוּחִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃

PSA 77:4.KJV: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
PSA 77:4.BHSA: אָ֭חַזְתָּ שְׁמֻרֹ֣ות עֵינָ֑י נִ֝פְעַ֗מְתִּי וְלֹ֣א אֲדַבֵּֽר׃

PSA 77:5.KJV: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

PSA 77:6.KJV: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
PSA 77:6.BHSA: אֶֽזְכְּרָ֥ה נְגִינָתִ֗י בַּ֫לָּ֥יְלָה עִם־לְבָבִ֥י אָשִׂ֑יחָה וַיְחַפֵּ֥שׂ רוּחִֽי׃

PSA 77:7.KJV: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
PSA 77:7.BHSA: הַֽ֭לְעֹולָמִים יִזְנַ֥ח׀ אֲדֹנָ֑י וְלֹֽא־יֹסִ֖יף לִרְצֹ֣ות עֹֽוד׃

PSA 77:8.KJV: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?
PSA 77:8.BHSA: הֶאָפֵ֣ס לָנֶ֣צַח חַסְדֹּ֑ו גָּ֥מַר אֹ֝֗מֶר לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃

PSA 77:9.KJV: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
PSA 77:9.BHSA: הֲשָׁכַ֣ח חַנֹּ֣ות אֵ֑ל אִם־קָפַ֥ץ בְּ֝אַ֗ף רַחֲמָ֥יו סֶֽלָה׃

PSA 77:10.KJV: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.
PSA 77:10.BHSA: וָ֭אֹמַר חַלֹּ֣ותִי הִ֑יא שְׁ֝נֹ֗ות יְמִ֣ין עֶלְיֹֽון׃

PSA 77:11.KJV: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.

PSA 77:12.KJV: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.

PSA 77:13.KJV: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?
PSA 77:13.BHSA: אֱ֭לֹהִים בַּקֹּ֣דֶשׁ דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ מִי־אֵ֥ל גָּ֝דֹ֗ול כֵּֽאלֹהִֽים׃

PSA 77:14.KJV: Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.
PSA 77:14.BHSA: אַתָּ֣ה הָ֭אֵל עֹ֣שֵׂה פֶ֑לֶא הֹודַ֖עְתָּ בָעַמִּ֣ים עֻזֶּֽךָ׃

PSA 77:15.KJV: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
PSA 77:15.BHSA: גָּאַ֣לְתָּ בִּזְרֹ֣ועַ עַמֶּ֑ךָ בְּנֵי־יַעֲקֹ֖ב וְיֹוסֵ֣ף סֶֽלָה׃

PSA 77:16.KJV: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
PSA 77:16.BHSA: רָ֘א֤וּךָ מַּ֨יִם׀ אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים רָא֣וּךָ מַּ֣יִם יָחִ֑ילוּ אַ֝֗ף יִרְגְּז֥וּ תְהֹמֹֽות׃

PSA 77:17.KJV: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.
PSA 77:17.BHSA: זֹ֤רְמוּ מַ֨יִם׀ עָבֹ֗ות קֹ֖ול נָתְנ֣וּ שְׁחָקִ֑ים אַף־חֲ֝צָצֶ֗יךָ יִתְהַלָּֽכוּ׃

PSA 77:18.KJV: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.
PSA 77:18.BHSA: קֹ֤ול רַעַמְךָ֨׀ בַּגַּלְגַּ֗ל הֵאִ֣ירוּ בְרָקִ֣ים תֵּבֵ֑ל רָגְזָ֖ה וַתִּרְעַ֣שׁ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

PSA 77:19.KJV: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.
PSA 77:19.BHSA: בַּיָּ֤ם דַּרְכֶּ֗ךָ ושׁביליך בְּמַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝עִקְּבֹותֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א נֹדָֽעוּ׃

PSA 77:20.KJV: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

records.name: Aaron
records.distinguisher: brother of Moses (EXO 4:14) and Levitical priest (EXO 28:1)

records.name: Joseph
records.distinguisher: eleventh-born son of Jacob and Rachel (GEN 30:24)

records.name: Moses
records.distinguisher: led Israel out of Egypt in the Exodus (EXO 13:3)
